bel_home_family.text: Tea is on and the cat is on the radiator. Between the two of them, I am a happy woman.
The wains are at school. 'Wain' is what we call a child here. It comes from 'wee ane', or wee one.
At dusk the starlets sit on the cranes by the hundred and have a chat. They are very loud, and very tidy about it.

then.text: Back for the Ulster Fry? Kitchen's yours.

else.text: You'll have had your breakfast? Sure, have another.
Everything in the one pan, and the farl and the potato bread go in last to mop up the fat. Mushrooms and a tomato if you're feeling fancy.
Pop in whenever you've got the makings. Use my kitchen.
